human_actions_required: Run the probe on the target Raspberry Pi Zero-class board.
Install the GPIO Python dependency used by the SeedSigner-compatible button HAT.
Install the SPI Python dependency used by the ST7789 display HAT.
Install the Pi camera Python dependency used by the OV5647/ZeroCam QR scanner.
Enable the Pi camera path in the boot config before hardware acceptance.
Enable SPI in the boot config before hardware acceptance.
Disable swap before signing acceptance so RAM-only secrets cannot page to storage.
Use a non-wireless Pi Zero or record clear Wi-Fi/Bluetooth block evidence.
limitations: This is a non-destructive development probe, not a completed hardware acceptance report.
A passing probe does not prove QR scan quality, trusted display readability, GPIO approval UX, or production security.
The Raspberry/Pi stateless QR vault remains RAM-only and must not add persistent secret storage or TROPIC01.
